holder-quote: He leapt down the hill, rushing at Montressa. She went pale and planted her staff in the ground. This time the ruby gemstone flashed illuminating the dark landscape.
effect-quote: The layered ward sprang around Montressa at the same time as the orb unleashed something like true lightning.

holder-quote: He called at his team. Yvlon saw a glow of magic as Montressa raised her staff.
effect-quote: The [Aegiscaster] was blocking nearly fifty feet by herself. Her glowing shields kept back the black shapes, the glowing forms pressed up against her barrier. Her staff glowed as the brass orb spat lightning. Yvlon felt her heart surge. She turned—

holder-quote: “I am attempting to be realistic and…humble. And frankly, Montressa proved she had more advanced spells than either Ceria or I can command. She allegedly blocked a bombardment spell from Liscor’s walls. Her [Five-Fold Arcane Barrier] spell is Tier 5.”
The mob was on them in a second. Someone yanked Erin off her feet. She punched a snarling face, heard Montressa shouting.
